flags.name: wallet-dir
flags.usage: Path to a wallet directory on-disk for Prysm validator accounts.

flags.usage: Path to a plain-text, .txt file containing your wallet password.

flags.name: account-password-file
flags.usage: Path to a plain-text, .txt file containing a password for a validator account.

flags.name: public-keys
flags.usage: Comma separated list of public key hex strings to specify on which validator accounts to perform a voluntary exit.

flags.name: beacon-rpc-provider
flags.usage:
WARNING: The gRPC API will remain the default and fully supported through v8 (expected in 2026) but will be eventually removed in favor of REST API..
		Beacon node RPC provider endpoint.

flags.name: validators-external-signer-url
flags.usage: URL for consensys' web3signer software to use with the Prysm validator client.

flags.name: validators-external-signer-public-keys
flags.usage: Comma separated list of public keys OR an external url endpoint for the validator to retrieve public keys from for usage with web3signer.

flags.name: grpc-max-msg-size
flags.usage:
WARNING: The gRPC API will remain the default and fully supported through v8 (expected in 2026) but will be eventually removed in favor of REST API..
		Integer to define max receive message call size (in bytes).
		If serving a public gRPC server, set this to a more reasonable size to avoid
		resource exhaustion from large messages. 
		Validators with as many as 10000 keys can be run with a max message size of less than 
		50Mb. The default here is set to a very high value for local users.

flags.name: tls-cert
flags.usage: Certificate for secure gRPC. Pass this and the tls-key flag in order to use gRPC securely.

flags.name: grpc-headers
flags.usage:
WARNING: The gRPC API will remain the default and fully supported through v8 (expected in 2026) but will be eventually removed in favor of REST API..
		Comma separated list of key value pairs to pass as gRPC headers for all gRPC calls.
		Example: --grpc-headers=key=value

flags.name: grpc-retries
flags.usage:
WARNING: The gRPC API will remain the default and fully supported through v8 (expected in 2026) but will be eventually removed in favor of REST API..
		Number of attempts to retry gRPC requests.

flags.name: grpc-retry-delay
flags.usage:
WARNING: The gRPC API will remain the default and fully supported through v8 (expected in 2026) but will be eventually removed in favor of REST API..
		Amount of time between gRPC retry requests.

flags.name: exit-all
flags.usage: Exits all validators. This will still require the staker to confirm a userprompt for the action.

flags.name: force-exit
flags.usage: Exits without displaying the confirmation prompt.

flags.name: exit-json-output-dir
flags.usage: Output directory to write voluntary exits as individual unencrypted JSON files. If this flag is provided, voluntary exits will be written to the provided directory and will not be broadcasted.
